name: Sam & Frodo
subtitle: Two hobbits, one Ring, and the long road to Mordor.

identity.mission: Two hobbits carry a burden far greater than themselves. The deck should feel like the long walk to Mordor — quiet loyalty, mounting dread, and the small acts of courage that matter most when all seems lost.

pillars.name: The Fellowship
pillars.description: Loyalty and support — the cards that protect and lift the ones beside them.

pillars.name: The Long Road
pillars.description: The journey itself: lands, landscapes, and the miles between the Shire and the Mountain.

pillars.name: The Ring's Burden
pillars.description: Temptation, sacrifice, and the cost of carrying what no one should have to.

identity.selection_rule: Rarity alone never determines the definitive printing.
